rules.name: Amphibious
rules.text: An amphibious vehicle can move directly forward only over otherwise impassible deep water at half speed by means of an Advance action. A vehicle cannot make any other action whilst moving over water - it cannot reverse, cannot turn, and will ignore all rules that otherwise oblige it to reverse or go Down. A vehicle that is immobilised whilst in the water is destroyed along with any occupants. Vehicles can shoot whilst afloat accept hull mounted weapons on vehicles equipped with floatation screen

rules.name: HE (1")

rules.name: HE (2")

rules.name: Howitzer
rules.text: Can either shoot directly at a target drawing its line of fire 'over open sights' in the normal way, or it can shoot indirect fire. When using indirect fire, a howitzer has a minimum range; when firing over open sights it has no minimum range.

rules.name: Low velocity light anti-tank gun
rules.text: This light anti-tank gun has a Pen rating of +3 instead of the usual +4.

rules.name: One-man turret
rules.text: Must make an order test when issuing an Advance order, even if the tank is not pinned. In addition, you can fire either the main gun or any rear-mounted machine gun, but not both in the same turn.

armyRules.name: Death Before Dishonour
armyRules.text: All Imperial Japanese infantry and artillery units have the Fanatics special rule. In addition, they automatically pass morale checks for being assaulted by enemy tanks (note that artillery pieces are still destroyed as normal).

armyRules.name: Banzai!
armyRules.text: A Japanese Officer may be given a special Banzai! order. This counts as a "You Men Snap to Action" with the following exceptions: If the order is given successfully, assign the officer a Run order die. Then

armyRules.name: ALL
armyRules.text: infantry units within 6” that haven’t already received an order that turn are issued a Run order. Note that this includes infantry units which cannot normally assault enemies, such as those with the Fixed special rule, or the Self-defence special rule. All infantry units can and will assault into close quarters if given the opportunity (09/2026 errata). Note that, other than for the initiating officer, no order test is required for any units affected by a Banzai! order. This means that affected units execute their Run orders automatically, without any dice rolled, and as such retain any pin markers they have.

armyRules.name: Lack of Radios
armyRules.text: When you give the Command Vehicle special rule to a vehicle that does not have it in its entry for the purposes of choosing a command vehicle for an Armoured Platoon, you can give it the rule for free instead of paying the normal +10pts. If you do so, the vehicle reduces the radius of its Command Vehicle rule from 12” to 6”. This represents communication by means of flags or hand signals.

rules.name: Open-topped
rules.text: Pinned by hits from small arms in the same way as soft-skins and infantry. If assaulted by infantry, open-topped armoured vehicles are destroyed automatically if the vehicle is damaged, in the same way as for soft-skins. If hit against top armour then add an additional +1 to the damage result roll. Note that all hits upon the upper surface of armoured vehicles count +1 penetration regardless of whether the target is open or not - so open-topped armoured vehicles suffer a double penalty: +1 penetration and +1 damage result

rules.name: Flak
rules.text: All enemy with the Flak special rule automatically fire at the attacking aircraft if the token model lies within their range and firing arc, regardless of whether they have already taken an action or not that turn. Flak fire does not require an action and takes place outside of the normal turn sequence. Firing a pintle-mounted machine gun flak weapon against an attacking aircraft does not make the vehicle count as open-topped for the turn. Any flak units in Ambush retain their Ambush status if they shoot at an aircraft. Hidden lose their hidden status. Friendly units must test to hold their fire (Inexperienced 4+, Regular 3+, Veteran 2+) - in case of Rookie pilot all flak units open fire automatically. Measure range - Line of Site ignored. Flak weapons not pinned hit on 5+, pinner hit on 6 - ignore all other modifiers. If HE hits, multiply as for inside a building. If 3 or more hits, shot down.

If you do so, the vehicle reduces the radius of its Command Vehicle rule from 12” to 6”. This represents communication by means of flags or hand signals.

rules.name: Command vehicle
rules.text: Adds a morale bonus of +1 to itself and to any other friendly vehicle within 12" (not cumulative with morale bonus, and other command vehicles). In addition, when it activates, it can use one 'You men, snap to action!' extra dice on any one friendly vehicle within 12", except for other command vehicles. Command vehicles count as platoon commanders for the purpose of receiving orders from other officers.

rules.name: HE (2")

rules.name: Howitzer
rules.text: Can either shoot directly at a target drawing its line of fire 'over open sights' in the normal way, or it can shoot indirect fire. When using indirect fire, a howitzer has a minimum range; when firing over open sights it has no minimum range.

rules.name: Slow
rules.text: Any vehicle with the Slow special rule has a basic move rate of 6" when Advancing and 12" at a Run.

armyRules.name: Death Before Dishonour
armyRules.text: All Imperial Japanese infantry and artillery units have the Fanatics special rule. In addition, they automatically pass morale checks for being assaulted by enemy tanks (note that artillery pieces are still destroyed as normal).

armyRules.name: Banzai!
armyRules.text: A Japanese Officer may be given a special Banzai! order. This counts as a "You Men Snap to Action" with the following exceptions: If the order is given successfully, assign the officer a Run order die. Then

armyRules.name: ALL
armyRules.text: infantry units within 6” that haven’t already received an order that turn are issued a Run order. Note that this includes infantry units which cannot normally assault enemies, such as those with the Fixed special rule, or the Self-defence special rule. All infantry units can and will assault into close quarters if given the opportunity (09/2026 errata). Note that, other than for the initiating officer, no order test is required for any units affected by a Banzai! order. This means that affected units execute their Run orders automatically, without any dice rolled, and as such retain any pin markers they have.

rules.name: Amphibious
rules.text: An amphibious vehicle can move directly forward only over otherwise impassible deep water at half speed by means of an Advance action. A vehicle cannot make any other action whilst moving over water - it cannot reverse, cannot turn, and will ignore all rules that otherwise oblige it to reverse or go Down. A vehicle that is immobilised whilst in the water is destroyed along with any occupants. Vehicles can shoot whilst afloat accept hull mounted weapons on vehicles equipped with floatation screen

rules.name: Open-topped
rules.text: Pinned by hits from small arms in the same way as soft-skins and infantry. If assaulted by infantry, open-topped armoured vehicles are destroyed automatically if the vehicle is damaged, in the same way as for soft-skins. If hit against top armour then add an additional +1 to the damage result roll. Note that all hits upon the upper surface of armoured vehicles count +1 penetration regardless of whether the target is open or not - so open-topped armoured vehicles suffer a double penalty: +1 penetration and +1 damage result

profile.Weapons: 1 platform-mounted light autocannon with 360-degree arc of fire

rules.name: Flak
rules.text: All enemy with the Flak special rule automatically fire at the attacking aircraft if the token model lies within their range and firing arc, regardless of whether they have already taken an action or not that turn. Flak fire does not require an action and takes place outside of the normal turn sequence. Firing a pintle-mounted machine gun flak weapon against an attacking aircraft does not make the vehicle count as open-topped for the turn. Any flak units in Ambush retain their Ambush status if they shoot at an aircraft. Hidden lose their hidden status. Friendly units must test to hold their fire (Inexperienced 4+, Regular 3+, Veteran 2+) - in case of Rookie pilot all flak units open fire automatically. Measure range - Line of Site ignored. Flak weapons not pinned hit on 5+, pinner hit on 6 - ignore all other modifiers. If HE hits, multiply as for inside a building. If 3 or more hits, shot down.
